subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should built-in compaction use the same aborted-turn drop policy as the prompt-send sanitizer for orphaned assistant tool-call turns?
rationale: The code is narrow and tested, but the permanent behavior choice trades small context loss for avoiding invalid provider transcripts and fabricated tool results.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR after exact-head review, making compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask for a different repair that preserves the assistant turn with an explicit synthetic or ambiguous result instead of dropping it.

options.title: Split richer recovery
options.body: Land this blocker fix and track richer interrupted-turn recovery separately.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after exact-head review, making compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization.
